newsitem.title: USA: Ten McNeil Real Estate LP'S say bid inadequate.
newsitem.headline: Ten McNeil Real Estate LP'S say bid inadequate.

text.p: Ten McNeil Real Estate LPs said on Monday they were urging unitholders to reject unsolicited tenders offers from High River LP and financier Carl Icahn.
In filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnerships contend the offer is indequate and not in the best interests of the partnership or unitholders.
The partnerships have sued High River, Icahn and their affiliates, alleging the offers were made in violation of federal securities laws.
Icahn referred calls to his lawyer, Mark Weitzen, who declined comment.
